calendarNotes: San Juan Unified starts the 2025-2026 school year on August 14, 2025 and ends on June 9, 2026. The reviewed student calendar lists Labor Day, October 6 no school, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Break from November 24-28, Winter Recess from December 22-January 5, Presidents' Week Break from February 16-20, Spring Break from March 30-April 3, May 1-4 no school, Memorial Day, and teacher work or staff development days. No official 2025-2026 PDF URL was supplied for this school year.

calendarFaqs.q: When does San Juan Unified start school in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: San Juan Unified starts school on Thursday, August 14, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Thanksgiving Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Thanksgiving Break runs Monday, November 24 through Friday, November 28, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Winter Recess in 2025-2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Recess runs Monday, December 22, 2025 through Monday, January 5, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is San Juan Unified Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 30 through Friday, April 3, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for San Juan Unified in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Tuesday, June 9, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Why is there no San Juan Unified 2025-2026 PDF URL on this page?
calendarFaqs.a: No official 2025-2026 PDF URL was supplied for this school year. Families should use the official San Juan Unified calendar page for the source of record.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the San Juan Unified calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the San Juan Unified ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

customSections.label: San Juan Unified Calendar Overview 2025-2026
customSections.content: The San Juan Unified 2025-2026 student calendar provides districtwide student dates for school-year planning. Families can use it to track the first day of school, last day of school, Labor Day, Veterans Day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Recess, Presidents' Week Break, Spring Break, local holidays, no-school days, teacher work days, and staff development days.

customSections.label: How We Verify San Juan Unified Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official San Juan Unified calendar page and available student calendar files, then compares key dates such as first day, last day, Thanksgiving Break, Winter Recess, Presidents' Week Break, Spring Break, holidays, no-school days, teacher work days, and staff development days before converting the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

No official 2025-2026 PDF URL was supplied for this school year. The official San Juan Unified calendar page remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
